title: APISR 4x Anime Upscaler
description: Batch anime image super-resolution. Send image URLs under input.images to upscale with 4x APISR (CVPR 2024). Results are resized to 2048px wide by default and returned as base64 JPEG + AVIF, indexed in input order. Set options such as OUT_WIDTH, SPLIT_HORI_IMAGE_TO_HALF, and APISR_REPEAT_2X in the request input object.
